# `Q-2-26` — Unclosed Inline Footnote

> An inline footnote opens with `^[` but the closing `]` does
> not appear before the end of the block.

## What this means

Pandoc-style inline footnotes attach a parenthetical aside to the
text by wrapping the body in `^[ ... ]`. The opener `^[` must be
balanced by a matching `]` inside the same block. This error
fires when the closing bracket never appears.

## Why this happens

The closing bracket was deleted, or a literal `^[` was read as
an inline-footnote opener.

## How to fix

Complete the footnote with a `]` at the intended end, or escape
the opener so the parser treats it as plain text:

```markdown
The caret \^[is literal here].
```
